Name: Farmer's Notebook
Author: laparlinha
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Farmer's Notebook[/b][/size]
[i]An In-Game Planner, Calendar & Journal for Stardew Valley 1.6[/i][/center]
[line]

[font=sans-serif]It's day 25 of spring, and you're standing at the edge of the field with a seed packet in hand, doing the math in your head: will this crop make it before the season turns? Probably, you think. You plant anyway. Day 28 comes and the crop still hasn't matured, just needs one more day. Then summer arrives, and overnight the whole row is gone, not one harvest. You didn't need more seeds. You needed to know.[/font]

[font=sans-serif]That's the moment Farmer's Notebook exists for. Not a wiki tab pulling you out of the farm, not a spreadsheet on a second monitor: a notebook the game itself hands you, with a leather cover and hand-drawn stickers that looks like it belongs on your farmer's desk. It always knows what's worth planting, who's expecting a gift tomorrow, and what the season still has time for, so you never have to alt-tab away from Pelican Town again.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Press N. Your notebook opens. Everything you need is right there.[/b][/font]

[list]
[*][font=sans-serif]❤️ [b]Today[/b]: your daily dashboard[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]🔮 [b]Upcoming[/b]: the next three days, planned[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]🗓️ [b]Calendar[/b]: the full season, at a glance[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]📚 [b]Guide[/b]: forageables, fish, and bundles, without the wiki[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]⭐ [b]Goals[/b]: your biggest ambitions, pinned front and center[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]✅ [b]Tasks[/b]: reminders that work the way you do[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]🗒️ [b]Notes[/b]: a scratchpad for whatever doesn't fit elsewhere[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]📜 [b]Journal[/b]: a history of the farm, written for you[/font][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]✨ An Interface That Feels Like It Belongs[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]More than a menu, this is your farmer's personal notebook.[/font]

[list]
[*][font=sans-serif]Leather cover with a spiral-bound design[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Colored bookmark tabs for each section[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Decorative stickers and page illustrations[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Layouts unique to each save file, persistent between sessions[/font][/*]
[/list][font=sans-serif]It feels woven into your farm's story instead of floating above it.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]📖 Notebook Opening Animation[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]The first time you open the notebook each in-game day, a short cover animation plays. The cover gently hovers while waiting for input. Click it or wait five seconds to open it. The cover then rotates around the spine with the left edge fixed and the right edge sweeping inward for a natural page-turn perspective. Closing mirrors the motion with the back cover. Any later openings that day go straight to your content.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]❤️ Today Tab: Your Daily Dashboard[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Everything that matters today, at a glance.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Fortune & Weather[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]See today's luck and tomorrow's weather as soon as the notebook opens, with clear icons for quick reading.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Calendar Events[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]Birthdays, festivals, the Traveling Merchant, the Book Seller, and seasonal reminders. Pulled directly from game data. No setup needed.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Birthday Gift Suggestions[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]Click a birthday to expand details. You will see the villager's portrait and their loved, liked, and disliked gifts with item sprites and hover tooltips. No more last-minute wiki detours.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Planting Recommendations[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]Crops are sorted into tiers so you always know what to plant:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=sans-serif][b]Tier A[/b]: Highly recommended. Multiple harvests possible before season ends[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif][b]Tier B[/b]: Time-sensitive. Plant now or miss the window[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif][b]Tier C[/b]: Informational. Season ends before this crop matures[/font][/*]
[/list][font=sans-serif]Click any crop icon to create a planting task instantly.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Fishing Alert[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]A quick nudge on good fishing days: how many fish species are in season, with an extra note when it's raining, since some fish only bite in the rain. Want the full breakdown with locations and time windows? That's what the Guide tab is for.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]🌾 Harvest Forecast: Know What's Ready[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Your planted crops are scanned to show:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=sans-serif]Crops ready to harvest today[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Growing crops with days remaining[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Expected harvest count for multi-harvest crops[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Crop sprites for quick identification[/font][/*]
[/list][font=sans-serif]Works on the Farm, in the Greenhouse, and on Ginger Island. Anything not ready today is included automatically in the Upcoming tab forecast.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]🔮 Upcoming Tab: Plan Ahead[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Look three days forward before you turn in for the night.[/font]

[font=sans-serif]You will see birthdays (with gift suggestions), festivals, merchant visits, seasonal reminders, your scheduled tasks, and upcoming harvests, grouped under clear labels ([i]"Tomorrow"[/i], [i]"In 2 days"[/i], [i]"In 3 days"[/i]).[/font]

[font=sans-serif]Season changes and the end of the year are handled cleanly so nothing catches you off guard.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]🗓️ Calendar: Full Seasonal Overview[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]A complete in-game calendar across all four seasons. Move between seasons freely. Each day shows birthday markers, festivals, merchant visits, passive seasonal events, and your task count. Click any date to open a detail page with its full event list and your tasks.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]📚 Guide Tab: Quick Reference Without Leaving the Game[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Forageables[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]Every seasonal forageable, one line per item. Hover to see everywhere it grows.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Fish Guide[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]Seasonal availability, locations, rain-only flags, and time windows for every catchable fish. Hover any fish to see how many you have caught and your size record.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Community Center Tracker[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]Shows incomplete bundles with required items and remaining quantities, and displays a completion message when you finish the Community Center. The tab stays hidden until you have actually met the Junimos in-game. Your farmer does not keep notes on something he has not discovered yet.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]✅ Tasks: Reminders That Work the Way You Do[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Create reminders with three task types:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=sans-serif][b]One-Time[/b]: Scheduled for a specific date ([i]"Buy Pumpkin Seeds on Spring 12"[/i])[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif][b]Daily[/b]: Resets every morning ([i]"Check Crab Pots"[/i], [i]"Pet Animals"[/i])[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif][b]Weekly[/b]: Repeats on a day of the week ([i]"Collect Kegs on Monday"[/i])[/font][/*]
[/list][font=sans-serif]If you miss something, it moves to an [b]Overdue[/b] section so it is not forgotten. Starting a planting task from a crop recommendation is one click, and the task is created with the crop icon attached.[/font]

[font=sans-serif]The dedicated [b]Tasks tab[/b] lists every open task in one place, sorted chronologically up to three years ahead. Daily and Weekly tasks have their own groups (one for Daily, one per weekday). One-time tasks are grouped by year so long-term plans stay organized.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]⭐ Goals: Your Biggest Ambitions[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Track meaningful milestones:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=sans-serif]Complete the Community Center[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Reach Farming Level 10[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Build a Deluxe Barn[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Catch every legendary fish[/font][/*]
[/list][font=sans-serif]Pin up to three goals to feature them at the top of every tab. Keep them visible, then mark them complete when you get there.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]📜 Journal: A Record of What You've Done[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Completed tasks, finished goals, and personal firsts, like your first catch of each fish or your first kill of each monster type, are all logged automatically with season, day, and year. Entries are grouped by day and shown newest first. Over time, your journal becomes a natural history of the farm with zero writing required.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]📤 Export Your Notebook: A Keepsake of the Farm[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]New in v3.7.0. Turn your notebook into a self-contained HTML page, a memoir of the farm laid out to look like the notebook itself, with your Journal history, Notes, and every completed Goal and Task included.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]How to use it[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]Enable "Export data" in Generic Mod Config Menu, then just go to sleep. The export happens the next morning, after your save is safely written, so nothing gets captured that didn't actually happen. You'll get a confirmation message when it's scheduled.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Where the file goes[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]The HTML file is saved next to your save folder, named with your farm's name and a timestamp, so exporting again never overwrites an earlier one. Open it in any web browser to read it.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Printing it (or saving as a PDF)[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]Once it's open in your browser, use the browser's Print option (Ctrl+P on Windows) and choose "Save as PDF" instead of a physical printer. That gives you a clean PDF copy of your farm's history, no extra steps needed.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]A note on mobile[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]This feature has not been tested on Android/mobile. It should work if the file can be opened in a mobile browser, but the file-location and printing steps above assume a desktop.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]🗒️ Notes: A Page for Whatever Doesn't Fit Elsewhere[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Not every thought belongs on a calendar. Notes is a free-form scratchpad inside your notebook, up to 20 notes, each up to 2000 characters, for shopping lists, layout ideas, reminders to yourself that don't have a date attached. Each note gets its own random sticker so the page still feels handwritten, not like a text field bolted onto a menu.[/font]

[line]

[size=5][b]🌍 Localization[/b][/size]

Automatically follows your game's language setting. 
Currently available in:
[list]
[*]🇬🇧 [b]English[/b], [/*]
[*]🇧🇷 [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b], [/*]
[*]🇮🇹 [b]Italian[/b], [/*]
[*]🇰🇷 [b]Korean[/b] (thanks to community contributor [b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/jjongleee]jjongleee[/url][/b]!), [/*]
[*][b]Chinese[/b] (🇨🇳 Simplified, contributed by [b][url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/118168688-wildstonehan1/]WildStone[/url][/b], and 🇹🇼 Traditional/Taiwan, contributed by [b][url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194463848-jiawanshen/]jiawanshen[/url][/b]; see the mod's i18n folder for how to switch to Traditional Chinese). [/*]
[*]🇯🇵 [b]Japanese[/b] (thanks to community contributor [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/OSHIKAWA]OSHIKAWA[/url][/b]!),[/*]
[*]🇪🇸 [b]Spanish[/b] (thanks to community contributor [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Backtech]Backtech[/url][/b]!),[/*]
[*]A 🇳🇱 [b]Dutch[/b] translation is also included, lovingly translated by my young daughter (thank you! 💛). Stardew Valley does not include Dutch as a built-in language, so see the mod's i18n folder for how to use it.[/*]
[*]🇫🇷 [b]French[/b] (thanks to community contributor [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/vin163]vin163[/url][/b]!), [/*]
[/list]
[line]

[center][font=sans-serif][b]Press N. Open your notebook. Plan your perfect farm.[/b][/font][/center]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]👥 Multiplayer: Everyone Gets Their Own Notebook[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]New in v3.5.3: every farmer in a multiplayer session gets a personal notebook. Tasks, goals, journal entries, stickers, and first-fish/first-monster milestones are tracked separately per player instead of one shared, host-only set. A task you create doesn't show up for your farmhands, and vice versa. Data lives on each player's own computer and loads for them each session (a farmhand switching computers won't carry their notebook along).[/font]

[font=sans-serif]Updating an existing save is safe: your current notebook automatically becomes your personal one, and nothing is deleted. The old save-wide data stays inside the save file as a backup.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]⚙️ Configuration (Optional)[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to access settings:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=sans-serif]Rebind the notebook hotkey (default: [b]N[/b])[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Show or hide crops you haven't seen yet in planting recommendations[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Show or hide fish you haven't caught yet in the Guide and fishing recommendation[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Require a minimum friendship level before a villager's birthday and gift suggestions appear (for players who like discovering things gradually)[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Show Community Center bundle requirements before you've unlocked the Community Center, if you'd rather plan ahead[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Show Desert and Ginger Island forageables/fish before you've unlocked those areas[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Choose how many pinned goals (1-3) show in the Featured Goals section[/font][/*]
[/list][line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=sans-serif]Stardew Valley 1.6[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]SMAPI 4.1.10 or later[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, for settings)[/font][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]❓ Common Issues[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif][b][size=3]The notebook does not open with N[/size][/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]Check for hotkey conflicts with another mod. Change the hotkey in Generic Mod Config Menu.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]The Book Seller does not appear on the calendar[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]Visit days are read from a part of the game's calendar data that isn't always available. If it can't be found, that feature is simply skipped, nothing crashes. Reloading the save usually fixes it.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]A crop does not appear in the planting alerts[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]Crops are recognized straight from the game's own crop data, including ones added by content mods, as long as they follow the standard format.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]I do not see planting suggestions for a crop I know[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]If "Show unknown crops" is disabled, only crops you have already encountered (sold, crafted, seen in shops, or found in your inventory) appear. Enable the option in GMCM to see all crops.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Birthday gifts do not appear[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]If a villager (including a modded one) has no gift information in the game's data, the gift section is hidden, but the birthday still shows on the calendar.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]A villager's birthday disappeared from the Calendar/Today/Upcoming[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]Check the "Min. Friendship for Birthdays" setting in GMCM. If it is above 0, birthdays are hidden until you reach that many friendship hearts. Set it to 0 to always show everyone.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]The Guide doesn't show Desert or Ginger Island forageables/fish[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]By default those regions appear only after you unlock them (repair the bus or Willy's boat). Enable "Show Locked Regions" in GMCM if you prefer to plan ahead.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]I don't see a Bundles tab in the Guide[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]The Bundles tab appears only after you meet the Junimos in-game (finish the "Rat Problem" quest and drink the Wizard's potion). The Mayor unlocking the door is not enough by itself, which matches the base game. Enable "Show Bundles Before Community Center Unlock" in GMCM if you would rather plan ahead.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]The Journal is empty[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]The Journal records tasks completed after installing version 3.0 or later. Tasks finished in earlier versions are not added retroactively.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]The interface appears in English even with the game set to Portuguese/Korean[/b][/font]
[font=sans-serif]Make sure the [i]i18n/[/i] folder is present inside [i]Mods/FarmersNotebook/[/i]. If it is missing, reinstall by copying the entire [i]FarmersNotebook[/i] folder from the archive.[/font]

[line]
[center][font=sans-serif]
Thank you for the endorsements, downloads, translations, and thoughtful comments. This small personal project has been a joy to build, and it is still growing with player feedback.  Bug reports and feature ideas are always welcome.[/font][/center]
